confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded estimates from aggregated cost-of-living sources (Numbeo-style crowdsourced figures and expat price guides), not inspected menus. Sources are undated or mixed-date, and several city-level figures are cross-checked against Medellín, Bogotá and Cartagena. Inexpensive meal and mid-range meal are the most reliable. Beer and coffee are moderately reliable, with the Cali-specific data thin. Cocktail is derived from the local beer relationship because no Cali cocktail price was found; wine by the glass is an estimate from bottle prices and typical restaurant markup. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and Cali's position as a mid-sized Colombian city, not from live listings. July is a mid-year Colombian holiday period, which may push some lodging prices up.
comparable_city_reasoning: No non-Colombian comparable city was used. Basis is Colombian domestic pricing in Cali, cross-checked against Medellín, Bogotá and Cartagena. Cocktail and wine-by-the-glass use the local price relationship to domestic draft beer where direct Cali data was weak. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a secondary Colombian city, as the user's country-level guidance requires.
